title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day before Emu's birthday
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh. I couldn't help but drop by.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We won't be doing any shows here at the Wonder Stage for a while...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we're going to learn and experience everything we can and come back with a bang!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright☆
Motivation, check! Energy, check! I'm gonna do my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Was someone here just now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An envelope! I'm pretty sure it wasn't there before...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, there's something written on the back...!

rows.Speaker: Mysterious Message
rows.Line:
“Open this on your birthday, when you're in a pinch.
K.S.H.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On my birthday? When I'm in a pinch?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: K.S.H. is probably the sender's name. I wonder who it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh well, that's for tomorrow☆
The letter said to open it on my birthday anyways!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okie dokie, time to go to school!
Doop dee doop doo♪
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good morning, everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? All of you are here! Even Airi and Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does this mean you're planning to do something fun?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's exactly right! And we were waiting for you to make it all the more fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, everyone, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're a day early, but happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, it's way too soon to thank us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our gift is going to render you speechless!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, your face...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. But I do have a good feeling that Emu is going to enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here Emu. This is your birthday gift from all of us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you! Oh, it smells like cookies!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. They are frosted cookies.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But they aren't just any regular frosted cookies. Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here's the guide. Why don't you take a look?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A guide?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “How to Assemble Your Own Cookie Wonder Stage”?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All you need to do is connect the cookies with chocolate and then you'll have your very own cookie Wonder Stage. I don't think it'll be too difficult, so I hope you'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: T-This is amazing! How did you make something like this?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, allow me to explain!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We first asked Kohane if she could give us lots of photos of the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she really did give us a lot. Probably about a hundred photos, I think...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought it would be good to have photos from many different angles...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've only ever seen the stage from the front, so it really helped us out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: On top of that, Kohane also helped make the guide too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I wanted to do something for you for your birthday. Also, the Wonder Stage is a very special place for me too since I've watched so many wonderful shows there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I wanted to do something to express my gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That makes me so so soooooo happy! Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was our pleasure♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Emu, you won't be able to do any shows with just the Wonder Stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you'll need a cast and backdrops too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wait, does this mean...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, our gift to you is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This!
A “Wonder Stage Transformation Kit!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've made marzipan figures of you and the others, as well as frosted cookie backgrounds.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Using the photos Kohane gave us as reference, we really zeroed in on the details for the costumes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we were making the backgrounds, Wonderlands×Showtime's shows naturally sprang to mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! I'd say that goes to show just how memorable they always are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, we're quite proud of how it turned out, so we hope you like them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
Amazing! This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you so much you guys!
I'm going to make the best Wonder Stage ever!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After you make it, please don't forget to eat it as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Don't worry, I'll be sure to enjoy both making and eating it☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you have some time after school today, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
After school
School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey! Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Mizuki, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was so surprised when I heard you two were coming to visit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course! It's your birthday, after all♪
We're pretty proud of how our gift turned out, so we couldn't wait to give it to you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here you are! We made some coloring sheets for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Coloring sheets?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. There's a variety of them in there, with some simpler ones and others that are a little more detailed. Feel free to color them however you like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
By the way...
I put that climactic scene from “The Popcorn Knight in the Pressure Cooker World!” in there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... That's an anime movie, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! It's a movie that me and Mizuki really like, and we couldn't stop talking about it when we went shopping at the mall last time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to color these in. Thank you so much, Ena, Mizuki☆

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. So many people have been wishing me a happy birthday and giving me gifts even though it's not even my birthday yet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, that's because everyone cares about you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Have lots of fun tomorrow, okay♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will!
